_about: Spurs financial-reporting inputs for the PSR / UEFA compliance model. Per-season reported figures are from the club's published accounts as summarised by The Swiss Ramble (2021-22 .. 2024-25). 'allowable_deductions_gbp_m' are ESTIMATES reconciled to Swiss Ramble's published 3-year window totals (see reference block); they are dominated by ~£60-70m/yr stadium & infrastructure depreciation plus COVID, women's-team, academy and community add-backs. Edit freely and re-run; nothing here is auto-generated. All GBP £m unless noted.
psr_annual_deductible_note: PL PSR max allowable loss = £105m over a rolling 3 seasons.

uefa._note: Football Earnings Rule = UEFA's PSR equivalent: max €5m loss, extendable toward €60m (and up to €90m) with equity. ENIC's £35m/€42m equity raised Spurs' allowable loss to €47m. Squad Cost Control caps (player wages + amortisation + agent fees) at 70% of (revenue + player-sale profit); player wages assumed 73% of the total wage bill per UEFA methodology; agent fees are a calibration estimate.

window_note: The current published PSR monitoring window. Its newest season is the anchor for the squad-cost ratio and the season the live transfer overlay is compared against.

reference._note: Published Swiss Ramble window totals, kept for validation. compute_psr() reconciles the per-season deductions to these. NB Swiss Ramble's stated £141m headroom is internally inconsistent with their +£26m adjusted result and £105m limit (which imply ~£131m); the model computes limit + adjusted result.
